about: The one pointer to the model of the robot as it is now. Every simulator, rehearsal, video and new training task loads this variant unless it states a historical model on purpose. Change it in the same commit that adds a newer dated variant, and update the robotics checkout's CURRENT-STATE.json fact battery_sim_model_20261104 (the key keeps its first name; its value is always the current model) to the same manifest hash.
describes: battery backpack with the Crazepony 2S 3000 mAh battery (frame and cap rev M5, print V1.47, screwed to the OpenRB box), old switch, DFR1202 and plug leads reused; A7Z on the orange V1.35 roof saddle without lid; U20CAM head with microphones and touch board. Masses estimated (CAD volume and listing), not weighed.
